# Adset Level
**1. First flow will down to Adset dimensions such as Adset Name, Campaign Name, TA Age Range and TA Interest Setup**
**2. Second flow will retrive to Adsets metrics such as impressions, reach, clicks, cpm, cpc, ctr, ad spend etc.**

# Campaign Level
**Get campaign level dimensions such as Campaign Name, Campaign Status, Campaign Objective and Goal Optimization and retrieve to Adsets metrics such as impressions, reach, clicks, cpm, cpc, ctr, ad spend etc.**

# Ad Level
**1. First flow will down to Ad dimensions such as Ad Name, Creative Id and Creative Name**
**2. Second flow will retrieve to each Ad metrics such as impressions, reach, clicks, cpm, cpc, ctr, ad spend etc.**
